references.text: Earlier in the chapter it is explained that the water will stop when the priests' feet touch the water
Describes how the priests stood on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan while the people crossed over
The water in the Jordan returned when the priests came up out of the river
Parallel to when God parted the Red Sea so that Israel could walk through on dry ground
Refers to the fact that the Jordan floods its banks throughout the harvest season
Reminds that the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant
The psalm describes how the Jordan turned back when Israel entered the land
Instructions that the Levites should carry the ark
Describes how the ark was to be carried with poles
